# Pocket2D

> A 2D game engine in C++26 with SDL3, Box2D 3 physics and Lua gameplay, built
> for agent-native play: the real runtime runs headless with structured
> actions, observations, deterministic stepping, replays and an MCP server.

Gameplay code is Lua component types; scenes, tilemaps, animations, items,
actions and scenarios are JSON. Agents drive a project through the JSONL
protocol (`game --headless --agent --project P`), the MCP server
(`game --headless --mcp --project P`) or the `tools/pocket` command line.

## Driving a game

- [Agent protocol](docs/development/agent-protocol.md): commands, observations, events, images, actions, replays and the MCP server
- [Agent command reference](docs/development/agent-commands.md): generated parameter schemas for every command
- [Command schema](scripting/api/agent-protocol.json): machine-readable source of the command reference and MCP tools
- [Scenarios and the Python client](docs/development/scenarios.md): tasks as data and the Gymnasium-style environment
- [pocket command line](docs/development/pocket-cli.md): check, test, run, replay, render and new

## Writing gameplay

- [Lua API index](docs/lua-api/index.md): the host API available to component scripts
- [Component model](docs/lua-api/component-model.md): lifecycle callbacks and component tables
- [Built-in components](docs/lua-api/builtin-components.md): Transform, SpriteRenderer, Rigidbody, ParticleSystem
- [Events and physics](docs/lua-api/events-physics.md): Event bus, raycasts, overlap queries, joints, character mover
- [Rendering, audio and input](docs/lua-api/rendering-audio-input.md): drawing, sound, keys, mouse and semantic actions
- [Lua type declarations](types/pocket2d.lua): LuaLS `---@meta` declarations generated from the curated host API
- [Host API contract](scripting/api/host-api.json): machine-readable source of the type declarations

## Project files

- [Asset schemas](scripting/api/schemas/): JSON Schemas for game.config, scenes, templates, tilemaps, animations, items, actions and scenarios
- [Tilemaps](docs/lua-api/tilemap.md): map format, layers and collision outlines
- [Sprite animation](docs/lua-api/sprite-animation.md): animation assets and playback
- [Inventory](docs/lua-api/inventory.md) and [Savegame](docs/lua-api/savegame.md)
